name: PROPHETIC 6
author: swtdr34mz
summary: A port of the PROPHET 67 firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1: a Prophet-6-style 7-voice analogue poly with two oscillators (sub, noise, sync, poly mod), a high-pass into a resonant 4-pole low-pass, two LFOs, distortion, chorus, delay, five reverbs, an arp on the MPC tempo and a low split. HIGH and ECO quality for the CPU. Panel-style touch pages.
